SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN valid_seq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_buyer_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_seq = 1 THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_seq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_seq >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_order_count
FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-15'
